subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit announcement remain open/pinned, or be retired now that CONTRIBUTING.md and automation enforce the 20-PR cap?
rationale: Source and release evidence show the policy is implemented, but the issue was deliberately reopened and pinned after that implementation, so the remaining choice is repository communications policy.

options.title: Keep Pinned Announcement
options.body: Leave the issue open and pinned as the visible contributor-queue policy notice while spam/PR-volume pressure remains high.

options.title: Retire Announcement
options.body: Unpin and close the issue if maintainers decide CONTRIBUTING.md and automation are now sufficient as the durable policy surface.

recommendation.title: Keep Pinned Announcement
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open and pinned as the visible contributor-queue policy notice while spam/PR-volume pressure remains high.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman made the latest visible policy-state changes by renaming, pinning, and reopening the issue after the docs PR merged.
